subject: Full-loop scheduling: Harper Lee — slate, debrief order, and calendar plan

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Harper Lee — availability for virtual full loop

Hi Marcus / Laura —

Hope you're both well. I'm reaching out with a strong candidate for the Product Engineer role: Harper Lee (resume attached). Harper is currently available the week of July 25 for a condensed virtual full loop (ideally 3–4 interviews in one day, with a short debrief after). They are in PDT.

Quick background: senior frontend engineer at a small ML SaaS company, strong system design + product sense. Hiring manager (Laura) indicated preference for a deep technical opener, product partner mid, and culture/leadership close.

Proposed windows from Harper (flexible):
- Mon 7/26: 9:30–13:00 PDT
- Wed 7/28: 10:00–14:00 PDT
- Thu 7/29: 12:00–16:00 PDT

Attached: Harper_Lee_Resume.pdf.

Can you confirm: preferred slot order, whether you want a dedicated coding exercise or live-coding portion, and who will own the 15–30 minute debrief? I'll pull calendar availability once you confirm.

Thanks — Emma

Subject: Re: Harper Lee — availability for virtual full loop

Thanks Emma — forwarding internally and proposing a sequencing that matches our hiring rubric.

On ordering: prefer
1) System design / architecture deep dive (45m) — technical interviewer (Jonas)
2) Live coding / implementation challenge (40m) — technical lead
3) Product sense & tradeoffs (30m) — hiring manager (Laura)
4) Culture / org-fitness + wrap (20m) — people ops / team lead

Request: keep a 30-minute buffer between 1 & 2 for short breaks and a 15-minute contiguous debrief block immediately after the loop (we usually block 30m: 15m evaluator notes + 15m final hiring manager decision).

Of the proposed dates, Monday 7/26 or Wednesday 7/28 work best for our interviewers. If possible, aim for 9:30–13:00 PDT on Mon 7/26 — that lets us run the slate and still have afternoon for follow-ups.

I'll draft the calendar invites and include a collated packet (rubrics, scoring guidance, debrief doc). Attaching an initial .ics for the proposed Monday window: FullLoop_Schedule_v1.ics.

Marcus Lin
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Marcus —

Thanks. Small tweaks from the hiring manager side:
- Swap the order so Jonas does the first deep dive (system + architecture), then the live implementation, then product. That gives us a strong technical signal up front.
- Keep live-coding to 30–40m but with a prepared prompt (no whiteboard free-for-all) — I'll add the prompt set to the packet.
- For debrief: I'd like the 30-minute post-loop to be split: first 10m immediate readout, next 20m for scoring. Please ensure all interviewers have the rubric link ahead of time.

Also: request that the candidate be told we may ask them to share their screen for the live-coding portion and that their laptop has Chrome + Zoom.

Drive folder with candidate packet here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz/candidate-packet-harper — I'll drop the prompt and Rubric_V1 there.

On availability: I can host 7/26 from 10:00–13:00 PDT (so if we start at 10:00 that might be simplest).

Laura Bennett
